comments.author: Ken
comments.body: where does a person find this book? i had a couple, but have no idea when or where i got them.

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: Most of the time it's a cash shop item; more specifically, released occasionally on Treasure Cove/Captains Ticket. I think you could also get it in-game from a Halloween event we had a year or two ago.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
When used in Transmutation Alchemy production (normal or Legacy) this item guarantees 100% transmutation success. All ingredients will be lost including the book itself, but you will receive your desired item as a trade-off.

It is sometimes available in the Cove/C-Ticket, and certain UWC packages as well.
